description: BQE WIM Data Year 4 Project (Implementation and Effectiveness of Autonomous Enforcement of Overweight Trucks in an Urban Infrastructure Environment) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Hani Nassif, Chaekuk Na (Rutgers University). BQE (Brooklyn-Queens Expressway) WIM Data for QB (Queens Bound) and SIB (Staten Island Bound). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
